item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out group strikes against industrial enterprises involved in the assembly of UAVs, logistics centres, and warehouses that distribute and supply military materiel to the AFU, as well as energy facilities that operate ports and facilities of the Ukranian logistics infrastructure. 💥 Attack UAVs and precision-guided air-based weapons inflicted damage on: 📍 in Odessa: ▫️ the Palma, Raben-Ukraine and Odessa-22 logistics centres , which store cargo intended to support the AFU; ▫️ UAV and their components assembly workshops, a missile and artillery weapons and ammunition depot; 📍 in Odessa region: ▫️ the Novaya Pochta logistics centre , which stores and distributes cargo intended to support the AFU, as well as UAV assembly workshops in the settlement of Ilichevka; ▫️ a logistics centre in Usatovo and the Blum logistics centre in the settlement of Teplodar, which keeps the cargo intended to support the AFU. ⏩ The following objects were also hit: 📍 in the port of Odessa: a dry cargo ship delivering cargo intended to provide support to the AFU; ▫️ Novaya and Usatovo power substations , which operate port and logistics infrastructure in Odessa and Nikolayev regions. 🔥 In addition, strikes were delivered at railway infrastructure facilities used to transport military cargo from European countries in western regions of Ukraine. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💥 Crews are in combat The T-72B3M crew celebrated the Tankman day in the very heat of war,
item.description: 💥 Crews are in combat ▫️ The T-72B3M crew celebrated the Tankman day in the very heat of war, turning the holiday into the day of the real feat. 🔥 At first, tankmen delivered precise strikes at the AFU's fortified defence area and destroyed it, eliminating up to 30 enemy personnel. But immediately after completing the task, a real hell began. ▫️ In anger, the enemy decided to revenge and lift up an entire swarm of FPV drones. The armoured vehicle was under heavy fire: the drones were circling around the position one by one, trying to find a vulnerable spot and destroy the crew. ▫️ In this deadly duel, Russian servicemen showed iron will and composure. The tank crew shot down more than 40 enemy drones one by one, leaving the battle as absolute winners. 🤝 We congratulate our heroes on the Tankman day and we wish them never get into such tough situations again! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Main strike force: how Ruslan Kurbanov's tankmen change combat course The commander of the tank battalion of the 40th Marine Brigade of the Vostok Group of Forces, lieutenant co
item.description: Main strike force: how Ruslan Kurbanov's tankmen change combat course ▫️ The commander of the tank battalion of the 40th Marine Brigade of the Vostok Group of Forces, lieutenant colonel Ruslan Kurbanov, together with his unit, celebrates a professional holiday on the front line. The officer is confident that tank remain the main strike force on the battlefield. ‘Without armoured units, nothing can be done, especially breakthroughs in deep echeloned defence. Armoured troops proved that they are the main strike force of the Ground Forces,’ notes Ruslan Kurbanov. 🔥 The battalion experienced tens of the most difficult operations. One day, the tankmen and the special forces servicemen were surrounded, but the tank crews refused to abandon their comrades. They took on a battle that lasted almost 23 hours, and already during the night they broke out of encirclement without losses, destroying a great deal of the enemy's hardware. Another time, precise tactics helped catch the enemy off guard: having formed eight columns led by tanks, the unit entered two settlements in just half an hour. ▫️ Today, Kurbanov's crews continue to perform tasks in the special military operation zone. They celebrate in their usual environment: in combat positions, near their vehicles and reliable comrades. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Battle banner presented to Chelyabinsk Higher Tank Command School Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation - Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of t
item.description: Battle banner presented to Chelyabinsk Higher Tank Command School 🤝 Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation - Chief of the Main Military and Political Directorate of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, General of the Army Viktor Goremykin presented the Battle banner to the Chief of the Chelyabinsk Higher Tank Command School, which was re-established in 2026. 🚩 In addition, the historical banners of the Chelyabinsk Technician Tank School and the Higher Tank Command School given in 1944 and 1968 were presented for School's exhibition. ❗️ The expansion of the higher military training institutions network is carried out as a part of the task of military education system modernising, which was assigned by the Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov during an expanded session of the Defence Ministry Board in December 2024. 💬 General of the Army Viktor Goremykin stressed that the revival of the Chelyabinsk Higher Tank Command School is not just an opening of another one training institution, but the return of the officer's school and the special military training system. The deputy head of the Russian Defence Ministry expressed confidence that the Battle banner of the restored Chelyabinsk Tank School will be a reliable bridge between the generations of cadets and officers, which will inspire professional skills and strengthen the comradeship. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Winners' successors in battle The T-80BVM tank crews of the 71st Motorised Rifle Division of the Sever Group of Forces
item.description: Winners' successors in battle ▫️ The T-80BVM tank crews of the 71st Motorised Rifle Division of the Sever Group of Forces continue to burn down the enemy's positions in Kharkov region. 💥 Every shot is precisely aimed at the target. The tank commander with the call sign 'Grom' told what does it mean to wear the proud Guards title on the front line: ‘Every day, we try to confirm the title of the Guards by our combat work, moving forward, pushing the Nazis away. We are fighting to keep our civilian population's sleep tight, not to shame the honour of our heroic ancestors, who beat Nazism 80 years ago in the same way. And we are fighting in memory of those who posthumously received the title of Heroes of Russia, those who gave their lives to defend our borders, to destroy these neo-fascists’. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement around the enemy's formations and expand the external control zone in Kharkov region. As a result of active actions, the control over the settlement of Chernyakov (Kharkov region) was established by the Russian troops. 💥 Strikes were delivered at the encircled AFU's manpower and hardware near Malaya Volchya, Budarki, and Buzovo (Kharkov region). 🔥 The enemy's manpower and hardware were hit on the outer perimeter of the encirclement close to Novoaleksandrovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region), as well as the destruction of the AFU's units continue to be carried out in the area of Olkhovatka (Kharkov region). The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement around the enemy's formations
and expand the external control zone in Kharkov region. As a result of active actions,
the control over the settlement of Chernyakov
(Kharkov region)
was established by the Russian troops.
💥
Strikes were delivered at
the encircled AFU's manpower and hardware near Malaya Volchya, Budarki, and Buzovo (Kharkov region).
🔥
The enemy's manpower and hardware were hit
on the outer perimeter of the encirclement
close to Novoaleksandrovka and Prikolotnoye (Kharkov region), as well as the destruction of the AFU's units continue to be carried out in the area of Olkhovatka (Kharkov region).
The enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement
near Sliznevo and Gogino (Kharkov region)
were thwarted.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, the enemy has lost up to 55 militants and one ground robotic system.
🔥
In addition,
in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at
formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two territorial defence brigades near Shevchenkovo, Staritsa, Novoselovka, Pogoreloye, Khatneye, and Fedorovka.
📍
In Sumy region,
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and one territorial defence brigade
were neutralised
close to Doroshovka, Velikaya Chernetchina, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Sennoye, Esman, and Krovnoye.
▪️
In total, up to 230 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, 18 motor vehicles, and one 155-mm Bogdana howitzer were neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of tree mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one presidential brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near Karpovka, Rubtsy, Beloye, Starodubovka (Donetsk People's Republic), Sobolevka, Solenoye, and Peski Radkovskiye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, one U.K.-made Braveheart self-propelled artillery system, and one Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system, as well as one electronic reconnaissance station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade near the settlements of Yasnogorka, Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Rayskoye, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Novoselovka, Nikolayevka, and Orekhovatka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 205 troops, two Kazak armoured fighting vehicles, and 17 motor vehicles. Two field artillery guns, including one 155-mm U.S.-made Paladin self-propelled artillery system, were neutralised.
👉

item.title: 🏭 To have health as strong as tank armour, and iron will! Andrei Belousov congratulated servicemen, veterans and employees of defence enterprises on the Tankman day
item.description: To have health as strong as tank armour, and iron will! Andrei Belousov congratulated servicemen, veterans and employees of defence enterprises on the Tankman day ‘Tankmen have written many heroic pages into our military history, always demonstrating unparalleled courage, steadfastness and mutual support. These qualities, along with professionalism and a sense of responsibility for Russia's fate, enable them to operate successfully during the special military operation," noted the Defence Minister. 🏭 Andrei Belousov stressed that scientists, designers, engineers and workers of tank-building plants, who create formidable combat vehicles, help tank crews reliably carry out combat missions. Thanks to them, tanks remain an effective weapon on the battlefield today and are not being retired. ▫️ The Defence Minister wished today's tank crews to multiply the glorious traditions of their predecessors, hone their military skills, and stand guard over Russia's sovereignty. 🤝 Thank you for your courage, and for your faithful and heroic service! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
